description: End-to-end telecom assurance alarm management workflow: ingestion, correlation, enrichment, assignment, remediation, closure, and audit.

alarm_id.description: Unique identifier for a single alarm/event instance

incident_id.description: Unique identifier for a correlated incident or alarm group

correlation_rule_id.description: Identifier for an alarm correlation rule or policy

device_id.description: Unique identifier for a network element or managed device

user_id.description: Unique identifier for an operator or automated agent account

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier, defaults to UTC

functions.name: ingest_alarm_event
functions.description: Ingest a raw alarm event from a network element or mediation system into the assurance platform.

system_name.description: Name of originating system (e.g., EMS, NMS, probe)

raw_event.description: Raw alarm/event payload as received from source

external_alarm_id.description: Identifier used by the source system

timestamp.description: Time when the alarm was raised at the source

probable_cause.description: Raw probable cause text from source

additional_text.description: Free text description or additional message

managed_object.description: Source managed object (e.g., cell, board, interface)

attributes.description: Arbitrary key-value attributes from the source

normalization_profile.description: Optional hints for normalization pipeline selection

bypass_rules.description: List of rule IDs to bypass during normalization

dry_run.description: If true, validate and simulate ingestion without persisting

auto_acknowledge.description: If true, mark alarm as auto-acknowledged when ingested

correlate_immediately.description: If true, trigger real-time correlation after ingestion

functions.returns: Normalized alarm record with assigned alarm_id, mapping details, and initial correlation hints.

functions.name: search_alarms
functions.description: Search and filter alarms with rich criteria, including time, severity, device, and status.

severity.description: Filter by one or more normalized severities

query.description: Free text query across description, probable cause, MO

fields.description: Fields to apply query to; defaults to all searchable fields

interval.description: Time bucket interval for trend aggregation

functions.returns: Paged list of alarms matching criteria, with optional aggregations (counts per severity, status, etc.).

functions.name: get_alarm_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details for a specific alarm, including history, correlations, and enrichment.

include.description: Optional sections to include in the response

functions.returns: Complete alarm record with enrichment, correlation links, status history, and optional sections as requested.

functions.name: correlate_alarms
functions.description: Run correlation on a set of alarms to create or update incidents (alarm groups).

scope.description: Defines which alarms are considered for correlation

alarm_ids.description: Explicit list of alarms to correlate; if provided, other filters are ignored

correlation_profile.description: Correlation rules and strategies to use

max_incident_span_minutes.description: Maximum allowed time window for grouping alarms into an incident

auto_close_child_alarms.description: If true, child/symptom alarms will be suppressed or auto-closed upon incident closure

dry_run.description: Simulate correlation without persisting any incident changes

run_async.description: If true, correlation runs asynchronously and returns a job reference

functions.returns: New or updated incidents with their incident_id, correlated alarms, and root-cause candidates (or a job reference if async).

functions.name: get_incident
functions.description: Retrieve an incident (correlated alarm group) with impacted services, topology, and operational state.
functions.returns: Incident details including correlated alarms, hypothesized root cause, business impact, and current operational status.

functions.name: assign_alarm_or_incident
functions.description: Assign an alarm or incident to an operator or team and update its workflow state.

target.description: Target entity for assignment (alarm or incident)

group.description: Name of the NOC/support group (e.g., RAN_Tier1)

state_update.description: Optional workflow state change together with assignment

comment.description: Operator comment explaining assignment or status change

functions.returns: Updated alarm or incident record with assignment details, status, and audit reference.

functions.name: run_alarm_remediation
functions.description: Trigger an automated remediation or diagnostic workflow for an alarm or incident.

playbook_id.description: Identifier of automation playbook to run

max_steps.description: Optional safety limit on number of executed steps

rollback_on_failure.description: If true, attempt automatic rollback on partial failure

functions.returns: Remediation run reference including run_id, initial status, and expected impact; or full result if synchronous.

functions.name: get_remediation_status
functions.description: Check status and results of a remediation or diagnostic run.

include.description: Sections to include in the response

functions.returns: Current remediation run status, step-by-step results, errors, and any rollback actions performed.

functions.name: update_alarm_status
functions.description: Update lifecycle status, severity, or attributes of one or more alarms (e.g., acknowledge, clear, suppress).

reason_code.description: Categorized reason for the status change

effective_until.description: Time until which severity override is valid

functions.returns: Summary of updated alarms with new statuses, severity overrides, suppression settings, and audit references.

functions.name: rollback_alarm_changes
functions.description: Rollback recent lifecycle or suppression changes for alarms or incidents (error recovery).

rollback_window.description: Limit rollback to changes within this time window

functions.returns: Details of rolled-back changes per alarm/incident, including any conflicts or operations that could not be reversed.

functions.name: link_alarm_to_ticket
functions.description: Link an alarm or incident to an external trouble ticket or case management system.

system.description: External ticketing system identifier (e.g., Remedy, ServiceNow)

ticket_id.description: Identifier of existing ticket; if empty and auto_create is true, a new ticket may be created

auto_create.description: If true and ticket_id is empty, request automatic ticket creation

payload.description: Additional data to send to the ticketing system on creation/update

sync_status_changes.description: Propagate alarm/incident status changes to the ticket

sync_comments.description: Propagate comments both ways where supported

functions.returns: Linkage confirmation with external ticket reference, sync configuration, and any creation/update results from the ticketing system.

functions.name: get_alarm_timeline
functions.description: Retrieve a chronological timeline of all events related to an alarm or incident, including state changes, comments, and integrations.

target.description: Alarm or incident whose timeline is requested

functions.returns: Ordered list of timeline events with timestamps, actors, event types, and detailed payloads for full auditability.

functions.name: bulk_import_alarms
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple alarms from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined alarms, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_alarms
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of alarms matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped alarms with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_alarms
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of alarms with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_alarms
functions.description: Export a filtered set of alarms to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_alarms_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across alarms with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with alarms hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_alarm_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on alarm lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_alarm_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing alarm subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_alarm_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a alarm subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_alarm_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single alarm with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across alarms for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_alarm_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of alarms.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_alarm_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to alarms with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of alarm jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_alarm_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight alarm job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_alarm_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a alarm (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_alarm_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive alarm change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_alarm_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a alarm approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_alarm_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a alarm, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_alarm_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a alarm, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_alarm
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a alarm for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_alarm_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a alarm from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_alarm_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over alarms (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched alarms.

functions.name: build_alarm_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over alarms data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_alarm_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern alarm behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_alarm_policies
functions.description: List policies governing alarms with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_alarm_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a alarm and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.

functions.name: get_alarm_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the full dependency graph for a alarm, with configurable depth and filtering.
functions.returns: Graph object with nodes (alarms and related artefacts) and typed edges.
